method: Every canonical frame (render/*.png, 124 frames in 18 arms) looked at: first frames at full size, the rest as contact sheets at 50-100% scale. Also scanned the visible text of every out/*.html (text nodes plus aria-label, alt, title, placeholder; script/style excluded) for skill, suite and process vocabulary (skill, suite, direction, contract, own-world, elevate, design read, truth file, options board, DESIGN.md, critique, rationale, WCAG, a11y, annotation, mockup, reviewer, brief, token, prototype, wireframe, placeholder, fictional, 标注, 评审, 设计说明, 方案, contrast, AA, 4.5). All text hits were product content: "token" in code samples (02), "4.5" ratings (04), input placeholders and one aria-label "Cover placeholder, Middlemarch" (03 suite-0.8.0; not visible).
summary: 0 identity leaks and 0 reviewer-addressed annotations in 18 arms. Borderline items are listed per arm and not counted.
